title: Pengenalan Passive Voice pada Headline
subtitle: Mengenal pola be + past participle di berita
objectives: Mengenal struktur dasar passive voice: be + past participle
Memahami makna kalimat passive yang sering muncul di headline
Membedakan kalimat aktif dan pasif sederhana

stages.name: Pembuka
stages.teacher_script: Selamat pagi! Kemarin kita belajar 'Have you heard about...?' Siapa bisa mulai satu percakapan singkat dengan pola itu? Bagus. Hari ini kita akan belajar passive voice, yang sering muncul di headline berita. Coba perhatikan headline berita: 'Three people injured in accident', 'New policy announced by government'. Kenapa pakai pola itu? Karena dalam berita, fokusnya pada peristiwa, bukan siapa yang melakukannya. Itulah yang akan kita pelajari. Rencana: kita pelajari struktur passive voice, lalu berlatih membuat headline berita.
stages.instructions: Sapa murid dan minta satu percakapan singkat dengan pola kemarin. Tunjukkan contoh headline berita. Jelaskan tujuan: belajar passive voice.

stages.name: Teori
stages.content:
## Apa Itu Passive Voice?

**Passive voice** adalah pola kalimat di mana **subjek menerima tindakan**, bukan melakukan. Dalam berita, passive voice sering dipakai karena fokusnya pada **peristiwa atau hasil**, bukan pelaku.

## Perbandingan Active vs Passive

- **Active:** subjek melakukan tindakan.
  - The storm **destroyed** many houses. (Badai menghancurkan rumah)
- **Passive:** subjek menerima tindakan.
  - Many houses **were destroyed** by the storm. (Rumah dihancurkan badai)

## Struktur Passive Voice

subjek + **to be** + **past participle (V3)** + (by + pelaku)

## Bentuk Passive di Berbagai Tense

| Tense | Struktur | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| Present simple | is/are + V3 | The news is broadcast every morning. |
| Past simple | was/were + V3 | Three people were injured in the accident. |
| Present perfect | has/have been + V3 | The result has been announced. |

## Contoh Headline Berita (Passive)

- Three people **were injured** in the accident.
- The election result **has been announced**.
- Many houses **were destroyed** by the storm.
- A new policy **has been announced** by the government.
- Rescue teams **have been sent** to the area.

## Kapan Memakai Passive Voice?

- Saat **pelaku tidak diketahui** atau tidak penting.
  - Three people were injured. (tidak penting siapa melukai)
- Saat **fokus pada hasil/peristiwa**.
  - Many houses were destroyed. (fokus pada rumah, bukan badai)
- Dalam **headline berita** untuk lebih singkat.
  - 'New policy announced' (bukan 'Government announces new policy')

> **Hindari:** memakai passive voice bila pelaku jelas dan penting. Active lebih langsung: 'The government announced the policy' (bukan 'The policy was announced by the government') bila pelakunya penting.

> **Catatan:** 'by + pelaku' opsional. Bila pelaku tidak penting, tidak perlu disebut: 'Three people were injured.' (tanpa 'by')

## Mini-dialogue

A: Did you read the news?
B: Yes. Three people were injured in the accident.
A: Has the cause been announced?
B: Not yet. The investigation is still ongoing.
key_points: Passive voice: subjek menerima tindakan, bukan melakukan.
Struktur: subjek + to be + past participle (V3) + (by + pelaku).
Passive di berbagai tense: is/are + V3 (present), was/were + V3 (past), has/have been + V3 (present perfect).
Dipakai saat pelaku tidak diketahui atau fokus pada hasil/peristiwa.
'by + pelaku' opsional, tidak perlu bila pelaku tidak penting.
Sering muncul di headline berita: 'Three people injured', 'New policy announced'.
Hindari passive bila pelaku jelas dan penting (active lebih langsung).

stages.name: Latihan
stages.instructions:
1) **Drill (4 menit):** Guru memberi kalimat active, murid ubah jadi passive.
2) **Fill-in-the-blank (5 menit):** Lengkapi 8 headline berita dengan bentuk passive yang tepat.
3) **Pair work (5 menit):** Baca headline, diskusikan dengan pasangan memakai passive voice.
4) **Role play (4 menit):** Dua murid memeragakan presenter berita membaca headline.
5) **Error correction (2 menit):** Perbaiki 3 kalimat salah (mis. 'Three people were injure' -> 'Three people were injured').

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: When the subject receives the action, not does it.
dialogue.id: Saat subjek menerima tindakan, bukan melakukannya.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Good. Change this to passive: 'The storm destroyed many houses.'
dialogue.id: Bagus. Ubah ini jadi passive: 'The storm destroyed many houses.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Many houses were destroyed by the storm.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Excellent. Make a present perfect passive headline.
dialogue.id: Bagus. Buat headline present perfect passive.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: The election result has been announced.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Now make a past simple passive about an accident.
dialogue.id: Sekarang buat past simple passive tentang kecelakaan.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Three people were injured in the accident.
dialogue.id: Tiga orang terluka dalam kecelakaan itu.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Good. When do we use passive voice?
dialogue.id: Bagus. Kapan kita pakai passive voice?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: When the actor is unknown or not important, or to focus on the event.
dialogue.id: Saat pelaku tidak diketahui atau tidak penting, atau untuk fokus pada peristiwa.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: It should be 'Three people were injured.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Because passive needs 'to be' + V3, and V3 of 'injure' is 'injured'.
dialogue.id: Karena passive butuh 'to be' + V3, dan V3 dari 'injure' yaitu 'injured'.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Rescue teams have been sent to the area.
dialogue.id: Tim penyelamat telah dikirim ke daerah itu.

stages.name: Penutup
stages.teacher_script: Hebat! Hari ini kalian sudah belajar passive voice untuk headline berita. Mari kita ingat: subjek + to be + V3, dengan 'by + pelaku' opsional. Coba saya tanya: kalau mau bilang 'Hasil telah diumumkan', bagaimana? Benar, 'The result has been announced.' Untuk PR, ubah 8 kalimat active menjadi passive dan tulis 4 headline berita memakai passive voice. Pertemuan berikutnya kita akan fokus mengulang kosakata berita dan media. Sampai jumpa!
stages.instructions: Tegaskan struktur passive voice. Berikan 1-2 pertanyaan pemahaman. Beri PR mengubah 8 kalimat dan menulis 4 headline. Umumkan topik kosakata berita.
